scientific_limitations: Only finite unweighted simple trees and a designated job-side vertex-ordered algorithm are considered.
The first-order sharp cutoff through 13 vertices is an exhaustive exact computation with a supplied inductively complete generator, not a symbolic classification theorem for all trees.
The infinite three-edge-arm spider family is proved analytically for every integer arm count.
Some older historically relevant papers were accessible only through abstracts or secondary citation, leaving priority uncertainty.
title: A sharp thirteen-vertex reversal between random-edge and random-vertex greedy matching on trees
